title: Apfelkäfig project config (v1)
description: Configuration for an apfelkäfig sandbox. Drop this file at the root of your project as .apfelkaefig.json to make the project akf-native (tier 2). The akf binary reads it at run time; no scripts get committed to the repo. JSONC: comments and trailing commas are allowed.

$schema.description: URL of the schema this config validates against. Optional; enables IDE autocomplete.

version.description: Schema version. Only `1` is accepted in this release.

image.description: The container image to launch. Omit to use the built-in ghcr.io/apfelkaefig/base image. Provide a string for a registry tag, or { dockerfile } to build locally.

dockerfile.description: Path to a Dockerfile relative to the project root (e.g. ".devcontainer/Dockerfile"). Requires Docker on the host.

mounts.description: Mounts in addition to the defaults (workspace + ~/.claude RW + ~/Downloads RO + ~/Desktop RO). Bind mounts by default; named volumes via type: "volume".

type.description: Mount kind. "bind" (default) maps a host path. "volume" uses an Apple `container` named volume; akf creates it idempotently before run.

source.description: For bind: host path; supports ${localEnv:VAR}, ${localWorkspaceFolder}, ${localWorkspaceFolderBasename}. For volume: literal volume name matching ^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9_.-]*$ (no substitutions).

env.description: Environment variables injected into the container. Values support ${localEnv:VAR}, ${localWorkspaceFolder}, ${localWorkspaceFolderBasename}.

user.description: User to run as inside the container. Defaults to "node".

workspaceFolder.description: Path inside the container where the project is mounted. Defaults to "/workspaces/${localWorkspaceFolderBasename}".

command.description: Command to run inside the container. Defaults to ["claude", "--dangerously-skip-permissions"]. String is split on whitespace; array is passed verbatim.

onepassword.description: Inject OP_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_TOKEN into the container. Implicit when the token is in the macOS keychain; set false to opt out, true to require.

plugins.description: Built-in akf plugin configuration. Plugins are curated capabilities shipped with akf, not repo-local executable code.
